title: 1.10 Who Is He? Who Are They?
unit_outcome: Understand and say short German sentences about people and what they are doing.
lesson_title: Who Is He? Who Are They?
sub_lesson_title: Who Is He? Who Are They?
goal: Ask who someone is with wer and answer with the family word.
grammar_function: Wer ist er/sie? Wer sind sie? Er/Sie ist ...; Sie sind ...
speaking_outcome: Ask who someone is and answer.
